title: OP OAK PREASURE PLATE
description: Super interesting datapack, designed for skyblock or oneblock better start or if you just want to get geard up fast in your own server before your friends. (Sneeky cheat code🫠)
body:
💎 The Ultimate OP Oak Pressure Plate
Why waste hours mining and crafting when you can get everything you need with a single click? This data pack adds a powerful function to the Oak Pressure Plate, making it the most valuable block in your world!

📦 How it Works
It's simple: You craft or find an Oak Pressure Plate, place it down, and break it. Instead of just the drop itself, you are going to get a Shulker Box filled with mid-to-high tier loot dropped right at your feet!

⚔️ What’s Inside?
This isn't just random trash. We’ve curated the loot to give you a massive head start:
The Arsenal: 2 Heavy Maces (enchanted with Breach IV and Density V), plus a powerful Sword.
Protection: A full set of Iron Armor Prot 4 to keep you safe from the start.
Utility: An Enchanting Table, Anvils, and plenty of Ender Pearls.
Survival: God Apples (Enchanted Golden Apples) for when things get messy.
And more: Various natural drops and essentials to kickstart your adventure.(On the gallery photo you can see all of the items).
Try and see for yourselves!
Take care and have fun!🎉
